patterns.note: The site uses a dark-themed, full-width section layout, often presenting content in asymmetrical blocks (large image + text) or multi-column grids of image cards.
All text uses sans-serif fonts, with large, bold headings for section titles and smaller, often uppercase labels for image card descriptions, maintaining high contrast against dark backgrounds.

A dominant dark charcoal background is used throughout the site, providing a high-contrast canvas for white text and vibrant architectural photography, creating a sophisticated, gallery-like aesthetic.

Sections and content blocks reveal with a subtle fade-in and slight slide-up animation as they enter the viewport, creating a smooth, progressive loading experience. The main navigation bar remains sticky at the top of the page.

Immersive image cards are a primary content delivery mechanism, used to introduce major categories like 'Studio' or 'Expertise', often paired with a concise text description or leading to a grid of related sub-topics.

technique_notes: Sections are revealed using a scroll-triggered animation system (likely AOS), where content blocks subtly fade in and slide up from the bottom as they enter the user's viewport, creating a smooth progressive disclosure of information. The main navigation bar maintains a fixed position at the top of the screen.

The site employs a dark mode aesthetic with a deep charcoal background and crisp white typography, enhancing the visual impact of high-quality architectural photography. Content is organized into full-width sections, often featuring large, immersive image cards that serve as entry points to detailed content, sometimes with a subtle overlay for text legibility.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold sans-serif headings (approx. 3-4x body) contrast with standard body text and small, uppercase sans-serif labels.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners (small radius) on image cards and input fields, maintaining a clean, modern edge.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, with generous vertical spacing between major sections and a comfortable rhythm within content blocks.

standout: The site's distinctive use of a consistently dark, almost black, background across all pages, paired with high-resolution architectural photography, creates an immersive, gallery-like experience. This sophisticated dark theme elevates the visual presentation of their projects, making the content feel premium and highly curated, rather than just informational.
